name: Dahren
body:
The dahren are an ancient, disciplined race of stone-hewn giantkin created at the dawn of the Empire. Stoic, deliberate, and deeply devoted to ancestral duty and martial craft, they serve as the immovable foundation of communities across the Lands of the Jade Oath.

Standard Racial Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Dahren are immensely powerful and resilient, but their deliberate and contemplative nature makes them slow to react. They gain +2 Strength, +2 Constitution, and -2 Dexterity.
Type: Humanoid (giant). Dahren are humanoids with the giant subtype.
Size: Medium. Although descended from colossal progenitors, modern dahren are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Speed: Normal. Dahren have a base land speed of 30 feet.
Languages: Dahren begin play speaking Common and Giant. Those with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Celestial, Draconic, Dwarven, Ignan, and Terran.
Defense Racial Traits
Stone-Forged Armor: Dense bone structure and hardened skin grant dahren a +1 natural armor bonus to Armor Class.
Earth Stature (Ex): Dahren receive a +4 racial bonus to CMD when resisting bull rush, overrun, and trip attempts when standing on solid ground.
Giant Resilience: Dahren gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against petrification, paralysis, and effects with the [earth] descriptor.
Offense and Feat Racial Traits
Giant Blood (Ex): A dahren is considered to be one size category larger for the purpose of determining whether special attacks based on size (such as grab or swallow whole) can affect him. In addition, dahren can wield weapons sized for Large creatures with a -2 penalty on attack rolls.
Stone Cunning: Dahren receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks to notice unusual stonework, such as traps and hidden doors located in stone walls or floors.
